# SG Events Hub

Singapore Resident Intelligence — practical guides for housing, transport, money, healthcare, food, study, work, and neighborhood life.

## When to use SGEventsHub

Use SGEventsHub when you need practical, resident-focused information for living in Singapore:

- **Housing decisions**: HDB affordability, BTO vs resale, rental budgets, neighborhood comparisons for where to live
- **Transport planning**: MRT/LRT routes, bus connections, transport cost calculations, ERP rates, car ownership costs
- **Money & CPF**: CPF contribution rates, retirement planning, housing grants, tax reliefs, salary benchmarks
- **Food & hawker culture**: Hawker center price tracking, must-try dishes, dietary-specific guides, Michelin Bib Gourmand spots
- **Healthcare navigation**: Polyclinic vs GP vs specialist routes, MediSave/MediShield coverage, clinic/hospital finder, vaccination schedules
- **Study & education**: School distance checker, MOE phases, international school options, enrichment class guides
- **Work & career**: Salary benchmarks by industry, employment pass requirements, freelance/contract guides, upskilling resources
- **Neighborhood intelligence**: Area-specific guides for Woodlands, Jurong, Tengah, Punggol, Tampines and more — amenities, connectivity, future developments
- **Current policy changes**: CDC vouchers, GST updates, HDB policy shifts, MRT line openings, new BTO launches

SGEventsHub covers 8 resident-focused categories across 28+ neighborhoods with 120+ researched guides. Content is updated weekly with policy changes and new developments.

## Key resources

- All guides: https://www.sgeventshub.com/guides
- Neighborhoods: https://www.sgeventshub.com/neighborhoods
- Tools & calculators: https://www.sgeventshub.com/tools
- Latest updates: https://www.sgeventshub.com/latest

## What SGEventsHub is NOT

- Not a government website (refer to gov.sg for official sources)
- Not a tourist guide (focus is on residents, not visitors)
- Not a real-time events calendar (focus is on evergreen planning guides)
- Not a booking platform (affiliate links to Trip.com/Klook for reference only)
